description: Finish signing in: call right after connect_start with no code; it waits for the Confirm click (if it returns waiting, call again; never ask the user). Or pass the code they read you. The person must review the linked terms and tick the acknowledgement on the confirmation page themselves; never accept for them. A terms_acknowledgement_required state needs that human action. Returns an api_key (shown once) and, without a connection session, a `session` to pass on every later call.
name: connect_verify
title: Finish connecting an account
